**TerraPulse AI: From Satellite Data to Earth Insights**

TerraPulse AI is an AI-powered environmental monitoring platform focused on Morocco, transforming NASA Earth observation data into actionable environmental insights. Using MODIS satellite data, the platform analyzes vegetation health through NDVI and land surface temperature (LST), while NASA FIRMS detects active fire hotspots using VIIRS observations.

The platform combines geospatial visualization, statistical trend analysis, anomaly detection, machine learning, and time-series forecasting to help identify environmental changes and monitor wildfire activity. Interactive dashboards allow users to explore historical patterns, investigate anomalies, visualize fire events, and examine environmental indicators across Morocco.

TerraPulse AI addresses the challenge of making complex satellite data accessible and useful for environmental monitoring and decision-making. By connecting Earth observation data with analytical tools, it aims to support researchers, environmental organizations, and decision-makers in understanding ecosystem changes, identifying potential risks, and promoting more informed environmental management.
details:
TerraPulse AI: From Satellite Data to Earth Insights

TerraPulse AI is an AI-powered environmental monitoring platform focused on Morocco. It transforms NASA Earth observation data into accessible environmental insights through geospatial visualization, statistical analysis, and machine learning.

The platform uses MODIS NDVI data to monitor vegetation health, MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) data to analyze surface temperature variations, and NASA FIRMS VIIRS observations to visualize active wildfire hotspots.

Users can explore environmental indicators through an interactive dashboard featuring a map explorer, historical trends, anomaly detection, time-series forecasting, wildfire monitoring, and environmental clustering.

The project aims to make satellite data easier to understand and use, supporting environmental researchers, organizations, and decision-makers in monitoring environmental changes and identifying potential risks.

Technology stack:

  • Python for data processing, analytics, and machine learning.
  • FastAPI for the backend API.
  • Next.js for the frontend.
  • Pandas, NumPy, Xarray, and Scikit-learn for data processing and machine learning.
  • MODIS and VIIRS satellite observations from NASA.
  • Geospatial visualization and interactive data dashboards.

TerraPulse AI is creative because it brings multiple NASA Earth observation datasets together in one interactive platform, connecting satellite monitoring with statistical analysis and machine learning.

During development, we considered data quality, spatial and temporal resolution, scientific reliability, model evaluation, accessibility, and the limitations of satellite observations. Our goal is to provide useful environmental insights without presenting statistical associations or model forecasts as guaranteed outcomes.
